requirements.quote: Supplier shall submit the design verification plan by week 4.
requirements.text: Submit the design verification plan by week 4.

requirements.quote: Freeze standard editions and regional applicability at G0 using those applicable on the RFP issue date; later regulatory changes follow change control.
requirements.text: Freeze standard editions and regional applicability at G0; follow change control for later regulatory changes.

requirements.quote: Test reports shall identify configuration, software version, sample serials, limits, equipment and calibration status.
requirements.text: Include configuration, software version, sample serials, limits, equipment, and calibration status in test reports.

requirements.quote: Accredited lab: IEC/EN 62368-1 safety; EN IEC 61000-6-2 industrial immunity; EN IEC 61000-6-4 emissions; FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A.
requirements.text: Use accredited labs for specified safety, immunity, emissions, and FCC compliance tests.

requirements.quote: Pass applicable limits on the released configuration. State any jurisdiction-specific approval gaps.
requirements.text: Ensure compliance with applicable limits and disclose jurisdiction-specific approval gaps.

requirements.quote: Provide EU RoHS 2011/65/EU including (EU) 2015/863 evidence, REACH SVHC declaration and applicable India BIS applicability assessment.
requirements.text: Provide evidence for EU RoHS, REACH SVHC, and India BIS compliance.

requirements.quote: No undisclosed restricted substances.
requirements.text: Ensure no undisclosed restricted substances are present.

requirements.quote: Buyer owns market declarations; supplier supplies the technical file and required testing.
requirements.text: Supplier provides technical file and testing; buyer owns market declarations.

requirements.quote: Six DVT units: powered -20 C and +60 C, 8 h at each; 10 thermal cycles -20/+60 C, 1 h dwell; separate 96 h 40 C/93% RH unpowered damp-heat test.
requirements.text: Perform specified environmental tests on six DVT units.

requirements.quote: All six pass functional checks before/after; no damage, data loss or corrosion. Humidity test per IEC 60068-2-78.
requirements.text: Ensure all six units pass functional checks and meet IEC 60068-2-78 humidity test standards.

requirements.quote: Three additional DVT units: ME-05 vibration/shock; three packaged units: ISTA 2A distribution sequence.
requirements.text: Test three DVT units for vibration/shock and three packaged units for ISTA 2A distribution sequence.

requirements.quote: All pass functional checks; no loose parts, rail release or product damage. Packaging remains protective.
requirements.text: Ensure functional checks pass, no damage occurs, and packaging remains protective.

requirements.quote: Zero unresolved mandatory failures or exploitable critical/high findings without written acceptance.
requirements.text: Ensure no unresolved mandatory failures or exploitable critical/high findings without written acceptance.

requirements.quote: Three DVT units: Section 6 workload, HW-07 update tests and HW-08 power cycling; independent security review of production configuration.
requirements.text: Perform specified tests and security review on three DVT units.

requirements.quote: 300-unit lot; calibrated production line; 30 consecutive samples for each agreed critical dimension/process characteristic.
requirements.text: Provide a 300-unit lot with calibrated production line and sample testing.

requirements.quote: First-pass yield >=98%; final functional pass 100%; Cpk >=1.33 on agreed stable, measurable characteristics.
requirements.text: Ensure specified yield, functional pass rate, and Cpk values.

requirements.quote: Any failed qualification item shall produce a corrective action and repeat of the affected test on three fresh units, or the larger sample required by the standard.
requirements.text: Address failed qualification items with corrective action and retesting.

requirements.quote: Supplier-funded retest is required for supplier-caused failures.
requirements.text: Supplier funds retests for failures caused by them.

requirements.quote: Reuse samples only under the approved test plan; retain at least five DVT units as reference units.
requirements.text: Reuse samples only with approval; retain five DVT units as references.

requirements.quote: Buyer may witness tests on ten business days notice.
requirements.text: Allow buyer to witness tests with ten business days notice.

requirements.quote: A gate is accepted only by signed approval against its deliverables.
requirements.text: Require signed approval for gate acceptance.

requirements.quote: Conditional acceptance shall list the open issue, owner, containment and due date; safety, regulatory and identity-security failures block release.
requirements.text: List open issues for conditional acceptance; block release for critical failures.

requirements.quote: Sampling does not waive the obligation that every delivered unit conforms.
requirements.text: Ensure all delivered units conform regardless of sampling.

requirements.quote: DVT provides 50 units. Allocate the above samples, destructive lab samples and retained references within that quantity; disclose the allocation in the bid.
requirements.text: Provide 50 DVT units and disclose sample allocation in the bid.

requirements.quote: If a proposed lab programme needs more units, price them explicitly on page 12.
requirements.text: Price additional units for lab programs explicitly on page 12.
